purpose: Tooling demonstration and beginner workflow rehearsal only.
warning: NOT A FORMAL RESEARCH POOL. The targets are publicly recognizable, the feedback locators can change, target classes are not statistically balanced, and repeated use creates pool-learning leakage. Replace with exact frozen feedback artifacts, symmetrical candidate construction, rights receipts, and a preregistered sampling rule before any study.
default_task: Describe the target associated with the opaque cue. Prioritize raw sensory and spatial information before interpretation.

targets.title: Old Faithful geyser erupting
targets.feedback_definition: The Old Faithful geyser during an eruption: a narrow vertical plume of hot water and steam rising from an open geothermal basin.
targets.rights_note: External National Park Service feedback locator. Link only; freeze and document an exact permitted feedback artifact for a formal pool.
